narrative.overview:
Workey reads like the log of a calm, well-coached runner. The 38-week DGS plan is periodised like marathon preparation: phases (Faz), weekly volume in minutes, a fixed number of sessions (seans). Each evening session is drawn the way a training app draws an interval workout, as three blocks of intensity on a time axis. Numbers do the talking, set large in a narrow condensed face like a sports-watch display; words explain them in a plain humanist sans.

The world is light and quiet: a pale grey-green ground, white panels, dark forest-green ink, and exactly three zone colours that belong to the three parts of a session (konu, soru, yanlış defteri). Nothing else is coloured. A missed evening is a measurement, not a verdict: it is hatched, labelled "cumartesiye taşındı", and the weekly total is shown unchanged. Streak and volume are figures in the log, never rewards.

Density is moderate and glanceable. On the phone at 20:30 the first panel answers the whole question: book reference, chapter title, page range, the session profile, one dark pill button.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white panels on a pale grey-green ground; no shadows, no nesting.
Three zone colours, each bound to one session part; everything else is ink, greys and line.
Condensed tabular numerals for every figure; humanist sans for every sentence.
State is carried by fill and pattern (ink, hatch, ochre outline, line grey, 3px rest stub), never by badges.
One primary action per surface: the dark ink pill "Tamamlandı".

rules.name: The Three Zones Rule
rules.body: z1, z2 and z3 mean konu, yanlış defteri and soru, in every chart, legend and swatch. They are never used for decoration, status, buttons or links. The only extra job allowed is z3's ochre outline marking today.

rules.name: The Soft Token Rule
rules.body: Tints are explicit tokens (z1-soft, z3-soft), never opacity modifiers on a variable colour. The production stack (templ + Tailwind standalone CLI) cannot compile `bg-[color:var(--z1)]/35`; add a named soft token instead.

rules.name: The Step-Up Rule
rules.body: On Today Sand, secondary text uses Moss Ink, never Lichen Ink (Lichen on Sand is 4.47:1, under the floor). The build already does this in today's list row.

rules.name: The Ink Label Rule
rules.body: Labels on zone-coloured blocks are Forest Ink, never white. White on Teal is 3.17:1. Ink on Ochre (5.44:1) and on Blue-Grey (5.64:1) pass; and ink on Teal (5.04:1, after z1 was retuned from #5b9c93) pass, so every zone block can carry a body-size Forest Ink label.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: If it is a number the user reads as a quantity (minutes, days, weeks, pages, percentages, nets), it is Barlow Condensed with tabular figures. If it is a sentence, it is Barlow. Times and page ranges inside running text keep Barlow with `tnum`.

rules.name: The Exact Notation Rule
rules.body: Book references are written in the user's notation, `M2·17, s. 210–225`: middle dot between book and chapter, "s." only for sayfa, en dash in ranges, decimal comma ("8,5", "1,5").

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase transforms anywhere. Turkish casing stays correct by never asking CSS to do it; if uppercase is ever unavoidable the element must sit under `lang="tr"` so i maps to İ.

rules.name: The First Panel Rule
rules.body: On Bugün, at any width, the first panel contains book reference, chapter, page range, session profile and "Tamamlandı" with no scrolling on a 390 x 844 screen.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to stand out, change its fill (Today Sand) or its content, never lift it with a shadow, blur or gradient.

dos: Do answer "Bugün ne çalışacağım?" in the first panel: book reference, chapter title, page range, session profile, then "Tamamlandı".
Do keep completion to one tap on the single Forest Ink pill.
Do state a missed or moved session plainly in words ("Salı yapılamadı; M1·2 cumartesi bloğuna eklendi.") alongside the hatched bar, and show weekly totals unchanged.
Do set every quantity in Barlow Condensed with tabular figures, and every sentence in Barlow.
Do write Turkish with correct ş ğ ı İ ç ö ü, sentence case, decimal comma, and the `M2·17, s. 210–225` notation.
Do put Forest Ink labels on zone blocks and keep all text at 4.5:1 or above; on Today Sand use Moss Ink for secondary text.
Do use the explicit soft tokens (z1-soft, z3-soft) for tints, and reference tokens instead of hard-coded hex in SVG fills.
Do use stroked SVG icons (1.8 stroke, round caps) and give every interactive element a visible focus state.
Do label sample figures as sample data until the plan arrives through the API.
donts: Don't use purple-blue gradients, or any colour gradient on a surface (the moved-bar hatch is a stripe pattern, not a gradient).
Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop blur or drop shadows on product surfaces.
Don't add badges, streak rewards, celebrations or confetti; Seri and hacim are measurements only.
Don't nest panels inside panels; use dividers inside a panel.
Don't ship lorem ipsum or other filler text.
Don't colour anything with z1, z2 or z3 that is not the matching session part (today's ochre ring excepted).
Don't put white text on a zone colour.
Don't use opacity modifiers on CSS-variable colours (`/35`); they do not compile in the production Tailwind CLI.
Don't mark a missed day in red or with warning icons; hatching plus a plain sentence is the whole treatment.
Don't uppercase labels or rely on CSS case transforms for Turkish text.
